notes: GO is genuinely earned. All 5 acceptance tests are real runtime integration spikes (spawned luca processes, real unix sockets, real kill -9, real reap-and-reacquire, 24 real latency samples) — none vacuous or mocked. The plan-review-flagged ac-09.2 concern is closed: test 4b asserts newLock.pid===daemon2.pid AND !==deadPid, proving the stale dead-pid lock is reaped and a fresh daemon re-acquires under a NEW pid (not merely that cold advance works). Additive-only safety holds: the 4 protected files (luca-state-advance/mutate-state/machine-verdict/stage-gate-hook) are absent from the changeset; pipeline-lock.ts and state/index.ts are export-only. Deviations judged acceptable for a POC: (1) `luca start` foreground-blocking with full daemonization deferred is spec-endorsed (plan allows stopping at Phase 1) and documented in summary caveat #1; (2) position-only mirror with counters authoritative in state.json is by-design (status handler reads counters from state.json, daemon.ts:161-167) and honors the persistence caveat (ac-12 serializable, anti-05 no snapshot). Minor observation (non-blocking): the ac-05 parity test asserts daemon reachability via status but does not assert mirrorStep advanced to 'verify'; the daemon advance WRITE route is instead independently exercised by ac-10 (28 direct socket advances, each asserted reachable), so the route is genuinely proven live across the suite. Bash was stage-gate-blocked for tsc/bun-test in verify — ac-14/ac-15 rely on the provided green checks-step evidence per the deferred/dual-evidence protocol; read-only git and grep probes were used for all structural anti-criteria.
